data.narrative:
Ark Robotics is a seed-stage company in Defense & Security founded by Achi Takagama. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 4 same-sector peers at seed and adjacent Series A stages, supplemented by reference to a broader peer set of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

A peer-median approach was applied across the 4 directly comparable companies. The median valuation across this set stands at $700M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A). UFORCE, the only seed-stage peer in the sample, carries a $1.0B valuation, while Singularity (Series A) is valued at $400M. This dispersion reflects stage and trajectory variance within the Defense & Security sector, though all comps occupy the high end of typical frontier-tech seed valuations.

The triangulated valuation range is $595M to $805M, centered on $700M. Given that only one methodological approach is currently applicable, this analysis rests on peer-median positioning rather than multi-method convergence. Key uncertainties include Ark's current funding stage specificity, relative product maturity versus the comparable set, and customer traction data. The $700M midpoint should be treated as an indicative anchor requiring validation against Ark's actual commercial progress and capital efficiency relative to identified peers.
